## 🔗 Related Issue

Addresses #2854 

---

## 📝 Summary

This PR fixes the flow when submitting the registration form for a gRPC service in the UI. Key changes:

* Add `handleGrpcServiceFormSubmit` in `admin.js` and bind it to the `add-grpc-service-form` form in `admin.html`
* Fix form submission action for `add-grpc-service-form` in `admin.html`
* Fix URL for `admin/grpc` in `viewGrpcMethods`
* Add missing `grpcFormError` in `admin.html`

commits.message:
fix: prevent prometheus registry contamination across metric tests

test_metrics.py was clearing the global REGISTRY without restoring it,
leaving registered gauges (app_info, database_info, etc.) that caused
ValueError: Duplicated timeseries when services/test_metrics.py ran after.

Fix by snapshotting and restoring the registry state in both test files.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix: eslint regex escape and robust prometheus registry cleanup

- Remove unnecessary escape in character class (\- -> -)
- Format long error string for prettier compliance
- Fix test fixture to clean registry before AND after each test,
  preventing cross-file contamination of prometheus gauges

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
